phases: Phase 1: Decision-record contract -- qor/scripts/adr_contract.py (vocabulary, record parser, tier-table parser; reads no ledger), doctrine-decision-records.md, backfill three ADRs (240 and 241 Implemented, 239 Accepted), three-column Tier 2 in the live index, the seed template and doctrine-governance-index.md, glossary with non-empty referenced_by on all three terms

Phase 2: Decision-record conformance detector -- qor/scripts/adr_status_lint.py with two ledger-free finding kinds and a __main__ guard, registered as a Check in status_json.default_registry, CLI dispatch proven by subprocess, FEATURE_INDEX FX028

Phase 3: One machine-author predicate -- attribution.is_machine_author becomes the sole implementation, doctrine-attribution.md defines the concept the glossary homes there, github_surface imports it and its docstring names the shared home, pr_citation_lint.is_exempt_actor delegates

limitations: The detector reads decision records only and never opens docs/META_LEDGER.md, so it cannot judge whether a declared status matches reality.

The three backfilled statuses are asserted on evidence recorded in LD-6; the roadmap record is Accepted rather than Implemented because SYSTEM_STATE.md:13, FEATURE_INDEX FX027 and seal entry #656 all describe a pilot with an open evaluation. They become machine-checked when Phase 259 ships the seal binding.
non_goals: Deciding whether a decision record's content is correct.
Any change to how /qor-status behaves without an explicit flag.
exclusions: The entire seal-binding surface: adr-status-stale, adr-phase-unsealed, the meta_ledger_walker plan field, the label-dialect predicate, and the consumer-contract fixture amendment. Carried to Phase 259; facts preserved in .agent/staging/PHASE259_SEED.md.
Branch pruning beyond the 104 gone-tracking refs already cleared, and workspace_fragility_check threshold tuning.
GH #431 and GH #432, filed separately 2026-09-04. GH #435 was filed during this phase on a false premise and is closed as an error of the plan author.
